noCodes: UMD publishes building numbers, not the letter codes Testudo schedules use: the Facilities Management building inventory (facilities.umd.edu/info-resources/building-inventory) and the campus map's public ArcGIS layer (services9.arcgis.com/1rOwFRpAwrxe0rBl BuildingAllSearch) list names and numbers only, and the registrar and Facilities glossary pages have no letter-code list (checked 2026-11-07).
